sn56.47:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, puriso mahāsamudde ekacchiggalaṃ yugaṃ pakkhipeyya. tatrassa kāṇo kacchapo. so vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena sakiṃ sakiṃ ummujjeyya.
sn56.47:1.3: api nu kho kāṇo kacchapo vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena sakiṃ sakiṃ ummujjanto amusmiṃ ekacchiggale yuge gīvaṃ paveseyyāti?
sn56.47:1.4: yadi nūna bhante, kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayenāti.
sn56.47:2.1: khippataraṃ kho so bhikkhave, kāṇo kacchapo vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena sakiṃ sakiṃ ummujjanto amusmiṃ ekacchiggale yuge gīvaṃ paveseyya, na tvevāhaṃ bhikkhave, sakiṃ vinipātagatena bālena manussattaṃ vadāmi.
sn56.47:4.1: tasmātiha bhikkhave, idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
